can: Consigo falar de trabalho e carreira com gerúndio e infinitivo corretos, e me apresentar em uma entrevista de emprego.

lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Trabalho (full-time, part-time, apply for, hire, fire, resign, promotion, qualifications, experience, CV).

items: "I have five years of experiences." Neste sentido *experience* é incontável. O certo é **five years of experience.**
"I sent my curriculum." O certo é **I sent my CV** (ou resume).

exercises.prompt: I'm looking for a ___ job because I only want to work mornings.
They decided to ___ him because he was always late.
I want to ___ for the manager position.
I have five years of experiences in this area.
acc: I have five years of experience in this area
I've five years of experience in this area

chat.scenario: Você conta a um amigo como é seu trabalho, atual ou ideal.
chat.role: Amigo curioso que pergunta sobre rotina, colegas e salário.

lessons.title: Gerúndio ou infinitivo
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: Verbo + -ing, verbo + to + infinitivo, preposição + -ing, stop doing x stop to do.

head: Depois de
Forma
Exemplo
rows: enjoy, avoid, finish, mind, suggest, keep, consider, give up
I enjoy working here. I suggest taking a break.
want, need, decide, hope, plan, manage, afford, refuse, promise, learn
I decided to apply. I can't afford to quit.
I'm good at solving problems. Before leaving, call me.
like, love, hate, prefer, start, begin
I love working here. / I love to work here.

items: **stop doing** = parar de fazer: *He stopped smoking.*
**stop to do** = parar para fazer: *He stopped to smoke.*
"I want that you help me." O certo é **I want you to help me.**
"I enjoy to work here." O certo é **I enjoy working here.**
"Thanks for come." O certo é **Thanks for coming.**

exercises.prompt: I want that you help me with the report.
acc: I want you to help me with the report

exercises.prompt: Explique a diferença: "He stopped smoking" x "He stopped to smoke".
exercises.ref: o primeiro é parou de fumar; o segundo é parou (o que fazia) para fumar.

lessons.title: Inglês prático, entrevista de emprego
lessons.goal: Usar o inglês prático da unidade: Entrevista de emprego.

head: Situação
Frases
rows: Thank you for seeing me. / I've been working in... for... years.
Tell me about yourself. / Why do you want this job? / What are your strengths? / Where do you see yourself in five years?
I'm good at... / I enjoy working in a team. / I'm hoping to develop my skills in...
What does a typical day look like? / Are there opportunities for promotion?
Thank you for your time. / I look forward to hearing from you.

items: "I have experience in work with clients." O certo é **experience in working with clients.**
"I'm very responsible person." O certo é **I'm a very responsible person.**

exercises.prompt: Where do you ___ yourself in five years?
I have experience in work with clients.
acc: I have experience in working with clients
I've experience in working with clients
I am a very responsible person

exercises.prompt: Responda a "What are your strengths?" com 2 pontos fortes.
exercises.note: Resposta livre. Pratique esta ideia na conversa com o professor.
